gloss: keen eye; sharp insight; penetrating gaze

definitions.gloss: keen eye; sharp insight; penetrating gaze
definitions.explanation: An eye or gaze that notices things others miss, or the ability to perceive things with unusual sharpness. Can refer to literal sharp eyesight or figurative perceptiveness.

examples.japanese: {鋭眼|えいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鋭眼|えいがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}がかり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見逃|みのが}さなかった→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧。
examples.english: The detective's sharp eye didn't miss any clues at the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批評家|ひひょうか}→批評家：19430_hihyouka⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鋭眼|えいがん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{若|わか}い⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧いち{早|はや}く⟦{見抜|みぬ}いた→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧。
examples.english: His keen critical eye was quick to recognize the talent of young writers.

notes:
Composed of {鋭|えい} (sharp, keen) + {眼|がん} (eye). A literary word that describes exceptional perceptiveness, whether literal visual acuity or figurative insight. Often used to praise someone's ability to notice or perceive things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鋭眼|えいがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧: a person with sharp eyes
- {鋭眼|えいがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見抜|みぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧: to see through with keen insight
- {鋭眼|えいがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{光|ひか}らせる→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to cast a sharp eye (over something)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{慧眼|けいがん}→慧眼：09115_keigan⟧: discerning eye — emphasizes wisdom and insight in judgment
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: sharp eye — the everyday expression
- {炯眼|けいがん}: piercing eye — a sharp, penetrating gaze
- {節穴|ふしあな}: knothole — used figuratively for someone who fails to notice things (the opposite)
